name: fasdnet_controls
description: FASD-Net / DPMixer control evidence for the fast-alarm and slow-diagnosis manuscript.
claim_boundary: Use the selected submitted run for FASD-Net main-text classification, localization, alarm MAE, and parameter count.
Dense alarm, shuffle, and reverse alarm controls are recorded from the selected control rerun unless a raw local artifact is added later.
The manuscript may claim the lowest alarm MAE among representative PSML baselines reproduced under the same current-environment protocol and strong localization relative to those baselines.
Do not claim universal SNN superiority, hardware energy reduction, floating-point operation reduction, optimized sparse-runtime efficiency, or that the spiking pathway improves all tasks.
